* cuda: add F16 input to the FWHT

The CUDA FWHT accepts F32 input only. This makes the source type a template
parameter, so the kernel reads an F16 source directly instead of requiring a
converted copy. The F32 path is unchanged.

items.title: Exa Launches Agent Ultra: A Subagent Swarm Deep Research API Built for Exhaustive List Building
items.description: Exa has released Agent Ultra, the highest effort mode of its Exa Agent API. It coordinates subagents across thousands of sources for list building and entity enrichment. Exa reports it beats Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Perplexity Agent on 4 benchmarks, including 81.4% soft recall on WANDR.
items.summary: Exa has launched Agent Ultra, an advanced subagent swarm API designed for extensive list building and entity enrichment, outperforming competitors like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra in key benchmarks. This tool is significant as it enhances capabilities in data collection and analysis for businesses.
items.summary_detailed: Exa has launched Agent Ultra, an advanced subagent swarm API designed for exhaustive list building and entity enrichment. This tool coordinates multiple subagents across numerous sources to outperform competitors like Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Perplexity Agent in key benchmarks, including achieving a high soft recall rate of 81.4% on WANDR.
